decisions.statement: A result bounded by anything says so rather than reading as the whole log.
An empty result says that finding nothing is no evidence of absence.
A bound that could not be determined is said as undetermined.
An empty result naming a pod other namespaces hold says those namespaces.
The limit is said before the window.
Nothing here fetches a log line.

definition: what bounded a log result, said in a line and named as a kind
